newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Tatarstan sees Eurobond by end-1997.
newsitem.headline: Tatarstan sees Eurobond by end-1997.

text.p: The President of Russia's autonomous Tatarstan republic, Mintimer Shaimiyev, said on Tuesday he expects Tatarstan to issue a Eurobond by the end of this year.
"I am sure we shall enter the Eurobond market by the end of the year," he told a news conference.
Shaimiyev said he expected Tatarstan to receive a credit rating no lower than the ratings on Russia's sovereign Eurobonds. Tatarstan officials are currently selecting a rating agency.
Russia's sovereign Eurobonds are rated Ba2 by Moody's, BB- by Standard & Poor's and BB+ by IBCA.
Previously Tatarstan has said it would raise up to $200 million by issuing a Eurobond in early 1998.
Tatarstan's Eurobond plans are separate to those for the Tatarstan oil company Tatneft, which also plans to issue a Eurobond.
